# opnsense_openvpn_generate_key (Ephemeral Resource)

Requires Terraform 1.10 or newer and OPNsense 26.7.6 or newer. The generated
key exists only for the operation and can feed only an ephemeral-compatible or
write-only consumer; it cannot feed an ordinary persisted resource attribute.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `key_type` (String) Key type: `secret`, `auth-token`, `tls-auth`, `tls-crypt`, or `tls-crypt-v2-server`. Defaults to `secret`.

### Read-Only

- `key` (String, Sensitive) Fresh generated key material, available only for the current operation.
